title: Ideal structure of $\ell^p$ uniform Roe algebras
summary: For a uniformly locally finite coarse space $(X,\mathcal E)$ and $p\in\{0\}\cup[1,\infty]$, we classify the nonzero geometric ideals of the $\ell^p$ uniform Roe algebra $B_u^p(X,\mathcal E)$ by the ideals of $\mathcal E$, equivalently by ideals in the associated family of controlled partial coverings. Hence the geometric ideal lattice is canonically independent of $p$.
